title: payments-service — Architecture Overview
body: payments-service is a Go service backed by a Postgres primary/replica pair for authorization state and a Kafka topic (payments.events) that ledger-service and the fraud-review pipeline both consume. External calls go to Stripe for card processing. The service exposes a gRPC API to checkout-service and a REST API for internal tooling. Scaling: horizontally autoscaled on GKE based on request queue depth, with a floor of 6 pods to keep connection pools warm — the floor that PAY-2114's fix made traffic-share-aware for canary pods specifically.
